title: Cardinals send reeling Rams to 2-4 and in danger of missing the playoffs with late rally aided by controversial penalty

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cardinals send reeling Rams to 2-4 and in danger of missing the playoffs with late rally aided by controversial penalty
sources.description: The Los Angeles Rams entered the season as favorites to win the Super Bowl. Through six weeks of the NFL season, they look like anything but after another tough-luck loss.
